hypothesis: First-output cost scales with total prompt length in addition to request count. Replacing accumulated generation length with prefill prompt tokens should explain the large increases for long-prompt batches.

pcvs.name: batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Measures per-output processing and output construction.

pcvs.expression: sum((o.finish_reason is not None for o in engine_core_outputs))
pcvs.name: finished_requests
pcvs.rationale: Measures completion statistics and request cleanup.

pcvs.expression: sum((self.request_states[o.request_id].is_prefilling for o in engine_core_outputs if o.request_id in self.request_states))
pcvs.name: prefilling_requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates first-output processing from subsequent decoding steps.

pcvs.expression: sum((self.request_states[o.request_id].prompt_len for o in engine_core_outputs if o.request_id in self.request_states and self.request_states[o.request_id].is_prefilling))
pcvs.name: prefill_prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Measures prompt-dependent work during initial detokenization; the largest unexplained costs occur on first outputs with long prompts.
